description: Window, screen, keyboard and taskbar tools with one tray and process-isolated plugins.
notes: Use the tray's Start with Windows entry after choosing the final install location.
Recording needs ffmpeg; optional RapidOCR and Tesseract engines need uv and tesseract.
GoldenDict integration and Flameshot handoff need those applications configured in their TOML files.
Exit Desktop Tools before upgrading or uninstalling. The persisted Profile/User directory is retained.
